Name: Jeush, Son of Shimei
Summary: Son of Shimei, named among the sons of Shimei.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 23:10: Son of Shimei, named among the sons of Shimei.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jeush stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
